::: {.cgp-controlbar}

::: {.cgp-controlbar-fold}

```{ojs}
// A phone folds the four groups below behind this one line, which says what
// they are set to and opens them on a tap. A wider screen never shows it.
controlSummary = {
  const parts = [GRADE_LABELS[grade], currency === "USD" ? "USD" : "Local", volumeLabel];
  // The Chain control only shows where the data has two.
  if (allBrands.length > 1) {
    parts.push(chain === "all" ? "Both chains" : BRAND_NAMES[chain] || chain);
  }
  // The cell runs again on every choice, so the button it replaces says
  // whether the controls are open.
  const bar = document.querySelector(".cgp-controlbar");
  const open = Boolean(bar && bar.classList.contains("is-open"));
  const button = html`<button type="button" class="cgp-controlbar-toggle"
    aria-controls="cgp-controls" aria-expanded=${String(open)}>
    <span class="cgp-controlbar-summary">${parts.join(" · ")}</span>
    <span class="cgp-controlbar-cue">${open ? "Done" : "Change"}</span>
  </button>`;
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const now = button.closest(".cgp-controlbar").classList.toggle("is-open");
    button.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(now));
    button.querySelector(".cgp-controlbar-cue").textContent = now ? "Done" : "Change";
  });
  return button;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof grade = radioControl(
  "grade",
  [["Regular", "regular"], ["Premium", "premium"], ["Diesel", "diesel"]],
  "regular",
  "Grade"
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof currency = radioControl(
  "currency",
  [["USD", "USD"], ["Local", "Local"]],
  "USD",
  "Currency"
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof volume = radioControl(
  "volume",
  [["per US gallon", "gal"], ["per litre", "litre"]],
  "gal",
  "Volume"
)
```

```{ojs}
// Only shown when the data has more than one chain.
viewof chain = {
  const entries = [["Both", "all"], ...allBrands.map((b) => [BRAND_NAMES[b] || b, b])];
  const input = radioControl("chain", entries, "all", "Chain");
  if (allBrands.length < 2) input.style.display = "none";
  return input;
}
```

::: {.cgp-freshness}

```{ojs}
freshnessNotice = {
  const now = nowTick;
  const items = [];
  const builtAge = hoursAgo(meta.built_at_utc, now);
  if (builtAge != null && builtAge > staleAfterHours) {
    items.push(`This site has not updated since ${meta.built_at_utc}.`);
  }
  const stale = [];
  // Each chain's feed where meta.json lists them, each country where not.
  for (const {label, captureId} of freshnessSources) {
    const when = captureIdToDate(captureId);
    if (!when) {
      stale.push(`${label} (never)`);
      continue;
    }
    const age = (now.getTime() - when.getTime()) / 3600000;
    if (age > staleAfterHours) stale.push(`${label} (${Math.floor(age)} h)`);
  }
  if (stale.length) {
    items.push(
      `Last successful capture over ${staleAfterHours} h ago: ${stale.join(", ")}.`
    );
  }
  if (!items.length) {
    return html`<div class="cgp-notice">Every country was captured in the last
      ${staleAfterHours} hours.</div>`;
  }
  return html`<div class="cgp-alert">${items.map((text) => html`<div>${text}</div>`)}</div>`;
}
```
